item.title: 16-year-old boy shot on Winthrop Avenue in New Haven
item.description: NEW HAVEN, Conn. (WTNH) — Police are investigating after a 16-year-old boy was shot on Tuesday in New Haven. The shooting took place some time before 4:30 in the 400 block of Winthrop Avenue. Police said the 16-year-old suffered non-life-threatening injuries. This is a developing story. Stay with News 8 for updates.
